title: Require reversible-site recovery on the mechanical loading clock
statement: For a deterministic/mean-field active fraction x before loading, constant disabled fraction0<p<1 per cycle and first-order inactive-site recovery r>=0 over Delta>0, put u=r*Delta,q=exp(-u). The recurrence x_next=1-[1-(1-p)*x]*q has unique fixed pre-load fraction(1-q)/[1-(1-p)*q] and fixed post-load fraction y=(1-p)*(1-q)/[1-(1-p)*q]. For0<R<1-p, y>=R iff u>=-ln(((1-p)-R)/((1-p)*(1-R))). R=1-p is only an infinite-u limit; R>1-p is impossible in this model.

requires: A declared deterministic/mean-field fraction model with identical constant cycle damage and a single first-order recovery law over each loading interval.
The post-load target belongs to that same active-site population; initialization, physical r,p and any connection from active fraction to service performance must be established separately.

assumptions: Nonuniform loads, stochastic population failure, correlated/common damage, irreversible scission and different recovery kinetics need their own models.
Cell growth and an effective sacrificial-network rate have different clocks; a measured chemical conversion cannot supply r or a fatigue threshold.
costs: Pay fast recovery time/mechanism, initial active population and slow replenishment of irreversibly lost material separately.
contract.units: p,x,y,q,R dimensionless; r inverse time,Delta time,u dimensionless. Mechanical work and recovery-rate certificates are distinct.
contract.obstruction: Acquire reversible mechanical recovery fast enough for the loading clock, in addition to biological reconstruction of matter.

body: The affine update has contraction factor(1-p)*q<1. Solve its fixed-point equation and multiply by1-p for the post-damage fraction; solving that inequality for q gives the recovery threshold. At r=0 the fixed fraction is0. The formula is a steady-cycle result: if the initial fraction is below the fixed point it does not certify the startup cycles; initial preparation/recovery must be charged. An initially higher fraction decreases toward the fixed point. The effective active fraction is not a probability that every region or load path survives, and no fracture/fatigue law is inferred from it. Slow cellular replacement of consumed matter is a distinct operation from re-forming sacrificial interactions between loading events. The source code reports convergence/threshold checks, but no actual wet-cellulose recovery rate is supplied or replayed.
